references.text: David, as a faithful servant, was appointed to lead Israel, which reflects the faithful and wise servant in Matthew 24:45.
Proverbs highlights the importance of being wise and understanding, qualities that are valued in the faithful servant.
The parable of the talents illustrates the significance of being a faithful and wise steward who manages what has been entrusted to him well.
Jesus asks a similar question about who the faithful and wise manager is, which mirrors the theme in Matthew 24:45.
Hebrews speaks of Jesus as the faithful high priest who serves on behalf of humanity, paralleling the faithful servant.
